general_news.summary: Pizza Hut has temporarily changed its name to "HUT" for the duration of the 2026 NFL season, which runs for 25 weeks. This marketing move involves covering the word "pizza" on some store signs and updating social media profiles. The name change comes as Yum! Brands, Inc. is in the process of selling Pizza Hut to LongRange Capital.
